2608.27940.title: A Deep Learning-Based Stacking Ensemble Framework for Turbofan Engine Remaining Useful Life Prediction
2608.27940.paper_summary: This study proposes a two-level stacking ensemble framework for Remaining Useful Life (RUL) prediction of turbofan engines, evaluated on the NASA C-MAPSS benchmark using the FD001 and FD003 subsets. The framework integrates four heterogeneous deep learning base learners: Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), CNN-LSTM, and CNN-GRU, whose out-of-fold predictions are combined by an XGBoost meta-learner to capture complex degradation patterns while mitigating individual model biases. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that the stacking ensemble achieves superior predictive performance, with Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) of 9.989 and 8.613, Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of 7.081 and 5.195, and R-squared values of 0.899 and 0.906 for FD001 and FD003, respectively. Compared to the best-reported baseline (TCAT: RMSE 11.12 and 11.02), the proposed method achieves RMSE reductions of 10.2 percent and 21.8 percent for FD001 and FD003, respectively. Feature correlation analysis, residual diagnostics, and training convergence curves validate the model's robustness. These findings underscore the efficacy of stacking ensemble methods for prognostics and health management in safety-critical aerospace applications.
2608.27940.paper_summary_zh: 這項研究提出了一個兩層堆疊集成框架，用於渦扇發動機的剩餘使用壽命（RUL）預測，並在NASA C-MAPSS基準上使用FD001和FD003子集進行評估。該框架整合了四個異質深度學習基學習器：長短期記憶（LSTM）、卷積神經網絡（CNN）、CNN-LSTM和CNN-GRU，其外部預測由XGBoost元學習器組合，以捕捉複雜的退化模式，同時減輕個別模型的偏差。全面的實驗表明，堆疊集成達到了優越的預測性能，FD001和FD003的均方根誤差（RMSE）分別為9.989和8.613，平均絕對誤差（MAE）分別為7.081和5.195，R平方值分別為0.899和0.906。與最佳報告的基準（TCAT：RMSE 11.12和11.02）相比，所提方法在FD001和FD003上分別實現了10.2%和21.8%的RMSE減少。特徵相關性分析、殘差診斷和訓練收斂曲線驗證了模型的穩健性。這些發現強調了堆疊集成方法在安全關鍵航空應用中的預測和健康管理的有效性。
